core_meaning.short_meaning: Humayra; little reddish-brown one, a byname of Aisha
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Humairaa corresponds to the Arabic form حميراء (Arabic root ح م ر (ḥ-m-r); حُمَيْرَاء (Ḥumayrāʾ)). Its core sense is humayra; little reddish-brown one, a byname of aisha. Humairaa is Arabic حُمَيْرَاء (Ḥumayrāʾ) 'little reddish-brown one', a byname of Aisha, from the root ح م ر (ḥ-m-r).
